title: "20" / "4" is 5: / converts both text operands to numbers

source.quote: Any argument passed as a string is automatically converted into a number
source.supports: the page says 20 / 4 and "20" / "4" return the same result

source.quote: The result is always decimal, unless a currency is divided by an integer or by a decimal; in this case, the result is currency.
source.supports: the result type of / and of DIVIDE

derivation: Both strings are converted to numbers, 20 and 4, and 20 / 4 = 5. No currency is involved, so the result of / is a decimal number (double).
